rules.name: target_down

provenance.derived_from: F06 (docs/CHAOS.md section 4, owner's run): min(up) is 0 at every reading from the first on (0 s after the inject). Baseline: up is 1 for every app target. State rule, so the margin rule does not apply and margin_ratio is null.

rules.description: A scrape target of an app service is down (up == 0 for 10 s). Root signal: the service named by the job label.

rules.name: container_missing

provenance.derived_from: F10 (postgres) and F13 (redis), docs/CHAOS.md section 4: the container series count is 0 within 10 s (5 s measured in the owner's runs); series of a stopped container disappear at the next scrape (D29). Baseline: 1 series per container. State rule, so the margin rule does not apply and margin_ratio is null.

rules.description: The cAdvisor series of an M1 container are gone (container stopped or removed). A missing subject is evaluated as 0. The guard makes the rule no_data while cAdvisor is down or shows none of the 6 containers.

rules.name: cpu_high

provenance.derived_from: F01 (orders): 90.92 % of the CPU limit 45 s after the inject (owner's run). Baselines are 1-minute averages in % of the CPU limit: orders 24.7 (docs/CHAOS.md) and 23.79 (owner's full chaos_check run) at 10 users; orders about 44, gateway about 40, inventory about 30, payments about 20 at 20 users (docs/BASELINE.md correction note, docs/OBSERVABILITY.md section 8). baseline_max 44 (orders, 20 users). Not used: the docker stats snapshot of docs/BASELINE.md section 5. Idle 13 to 15 %. Values above 100 occur.

rules.description: CPU use of a container above 85 % of its own CPU limit (1-minute average). The query is the Overview query 'CPU % of limit per container'.

rules.name: memory_high

provenance.derived_from: F02 (payments): 83.54 % of the memory limit 35 s after the inject, steady about 86 to 87 (owner's run). Baseline payments 23.9 (docs/CHAOS.md) and 29.06 (owner's full chaos_check run); docs/BASELINE.md section 5 shows no service above about 26 %. baseline_max 29.06.

rules.description: Memory working set of a container above 80 % of its memory limit. The query is the Overview query 'memory % of limit' per container.

rules.name: gateway_5xx_pct

provenance.derived_from: Query A of docs/CHAOS.md section 4 (wrapped in label_replace so that the subject is gateway). First readings (owner's runs): F08 6.26 after 0 s, F10 9.19 after 15 s, F11 8.864 after 15 s. Baseline: 0 % (an empty result counts as 0), so margin_ratio is null. The 17.7 % read right after an F06 recreate is the previous minute and is not a baseline (docs/CHAOS.md notes). Rate guard: evaluated only at 0.5 requests/s or more.

rules.description: Share of gateway requests answered with 5xx above 5 % for 15 s (1-minute window), only while the gateway receives at least 0.5 requests per second.

rules.name: dependency_errors

provenance.derived_from: dependency_requests_total with outcome other than success, errors per second (docs/CHAOS.md section 4). First readings (owner's runs): F08 orders 0.18 per s after 5 s, F13 0.50 per s after 10 s. Baseline: empty (counted as 0), so margin_ratio is null. The dependency goes into the symptom detail as dependency=<name>.

rules.description: A service sees more than 0.1 failed dependency calls per second for 10 s. The subject is the calling service (job); the failing dependency is named in the detail.

rules.name: latency_p95

provenance.derived_from: p95 per app service, 1-minute window, health, ready and metrics routes excluded. First readings (owner's runs): F18 gateway 0.955 s after 0 s, F11 inventory 1.507 s after 15 s. Baselines: gateway p95 0.1 to 0.2 s (docs/CHAOS.md) and about 203 ms on the dashboard at 20 users (docs/OBSERVABILITY.md section 8); inventory 0.01 s. baseline_max 0.203. Rate guard: evaluated only at 1 request/s or more per service.

rules.description: p95 request latency of an app service above 0.5 s for 15 s, only while that service receives at least 1 request per second.

rules.name: throughput_surge

provenance.derived_from: F18 query of docs/CHAOS.md section 4 (wrapped in label_replace so that the subject is gateway). F18 first reading above the threshold: 31.77 requests/s after 50 s (owner's full chaos_check run with a 10-user background load), plateau about 38. Baseline: 18.97 requests/s at 20 users (docs/BASELINE.md). baseline_max 18.97; 1.5 x 18.97 = 28.46.

rules.description: Gateway requests per second above 30 for 15 s (the 20-user baseline is about 19). Role load: a surge is a capacity problem, so the incident has no single root service.

rules.name: log_errors

provenance.derived_from: PENDING: the Loki baseline (WARNING and ERROR lines per service and minute, idle and with 10 users) has not been measured yet, so threshold 0 is provisional. Rule to apply: threshold >= 3 x the highest per-minute count seen. M3 evidence from other queries (2-minute windows, other filters): F06 2 lines, F08 12, F10 4, F13 1.

rules.description: WARNING and ERROR log lines of an app service in the last minute. Evidence only: it is attached to an open incident and never opens one (Loki is the weaker and later source).
